verdict.rationale: Abacum's security page documents a detailed edit history giving visibility into every edit event on data models, spaces and dimension mappings, which covers the logging half of the story. Nothing documents rolling back changes; scenario versions built off a base version are a different feature and earn no credit here. missing for 10: explicit who/what/when attribution in the log, rollback or restore of changes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, every change to the model is logged with who changed what and when, and can be rolled back

citations.quote: you can maintain a detailed history, offering full visibility into every edit event on your data models, spaces, or dimension mappings.
